provenance.method: For every run in the crew-chatter and team-notes targets with both a signed approval and a plan.gate.pass event: declaredPaths is the length of the approval row's signed scope (computeScope of the spec's declared artifacts); planItems is validatePlanDoc(plan).taskItems.length (the count the implementation stage phases by) of the plan whose normalized SHA-256 equals the planHash in that run's last plan.gate.pass event. The plan text was taken from a committed fixture where one exists, else the run's delivery branch, else the target checkout. Runs with no approval are left out. The plan texts are not copied here.
provenance.note: The 2026-10-10 learnings figure used five of these runs (crew-chatter 2, 3, 4; team-notes 6, 12) and a highest ratio of 1.84. The six other team-notes runs were found recoverable on 2026-10-12; team-notes run 10 (20 files, 52 items, 2.6) is the highest.
